entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? Uh, hi... I think I need to return something? I'm not really sure how this all works.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Isaac. I can definitely help you with a return. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... uh... VF88602. It's for the cycling shoes I bought a while ago. The whole process is just so confusing.

Thank you, Maria. I see your order for the Velo-Stride Pro cycling shoes, delivered 83 days ago. I can certainly look into this for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, um, a preference I guess? I finally tried them, and I could not get the cleats positioned right. I went for one ride and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I think I just ordered the wrong ones. The website had so many options... can't you just help me?

I'm very sorry to hear about the blisters; that's certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Getting the fit right is crucial. Since it's a matter of fit and not a defect, let me check our policy for you regarding a refund.
Okay... I hope you can. I'd really appreciate it.
One moment... Okay, I've confirmed it. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full return for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them. Thank you so much!

You're very welcome, Maria. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, we will issue the refund to your original payment method. You should see it within 3 to 5 business days after that.
That sounds perfect. Thank you for making it so easy.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again, Isaac.
You're welcome, Maria. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
